title: Juniper and the Border
author: Astrid Almeida
blurb: Rafael Eastwick, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
